# Naveed Ahmed

> Backend / Product Engineer building production APIs, SDKs, integrations, developer platforms, and AI-enabled backend systems.

Naveed Ahmed is a software engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. His work focuses on Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, asynchronous processing, SDK engineering, API integrations, production systems, and AI backend architecture.

## Selected Work

- [What I Build](https://naveedahmed.ai/#focus): Backend systems, developer platforms and SDKs, integrations, and AI-enabled backend systems, including Redis, BullMQ, and RabbitMQ-backed asynchronous work.
- [Rasterex](https://naveedahmed.ai/#work): Production SDK and integration engineering involving @rasterex/viewer, framework-independent integrations, iframe/PostMessage communication, developer documentation, and customer integration work for deployments across 50+ countries.
- [PlayLight](https://naveedahmed.ai/#playlight): Zero-to-one personalized AI backend architecture using NestJS, PostgreSQL, pgvector, embeddings, retrieval, persistent user context, and LLM APIs.

## Experience

- [Engineering Experience](https://naveedahmed.ai/#experience): Professional history spanning backend APIs, payments, scheduling integrations, SDKs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled products.

## Engineering Thinking

- [Engineering Thinking](https://naveedahmed.ai/#thinking): Technical investigations around Node.js, PostgreSQL, backend reliability, system design, retrieval systems, and performance.
